name: Mycelium Venimeux
description: Maître Mycélien connectant plusieurs colonies fongiques dispersées pour une action coordonnée simultanée sur plusieurs fronts.

loadout.armor_outfit: Mutated military tactical vest and chest plate, shattered and spread apart by internal fungal growths, plates held together by pulsing mycelium threads and living root networks, no symmetry, exposed necrotic flesh between armored sections, polypore shelf fungi growing on shoulders and back as organic pauldrons, lumpy fungal biomass replacing damaged areas, tattered military fabric integrated with living mold and spore-producing membranes
loadout.arsenal: Assimilated assault rifle with barrel completely engorged by pulsating fungal biomass, weapon fused with living tissue, organic ammunition sacs replaced by bulbous spore canisters hanging from magazine well, toxic green veins pulsating visibly along the weapon's length, thick ropes of mycelium wrapping around the grip and stock, muzzle constantly exuding clouds of toxic fluorescent green spores, secondary arm mounted with elongated fungal tendrils acting as organic whip or grappling appendage

attitude.behavior: Tactical coordinator standing with arms raised commanding allied fungal units, directing coordinated movements between multiple strains of the infestation, combat stance with weapon raised at head height aimed at approaching threat, body coiled and leaning forward with weight on back foot like a loaded spring, legs planted wide in aggressive stance, head tilted scanning battlefield through glowing mycological eyes
attitude.emotion: Cold biological imperative radiating from bioluminescent fungal eye clusters replacing human eyes, extreme predatory focus emanating from the central nervous system extended into the mycelial network, expressionless face masked by pulsating fungal growths but posture conveying lethal readiness and coordinated hive aggression

palette_names.name: Toxic Fluorescent Green
palette_names.role: Primary bioluminescent accent, spore clouds, mycelial veins, glowing fungal elements

palette_names.name: Dirty Khaki Green
palette_names.role: Dominant background and secondary structures, military equipment base

palette_names.name: Moist Earthy Brown
palette_names.role: Ground terrain, fungal mass foundations, decomposing matter

palette_names.name: Dark Asphalt Gray
palette_names.role: Shadow areas, distant structures, equipment metal

palette_names.name: Necrotic Flesh Pink
palette_names.role: Exposed biological matter, organic wounds, living tissue

palette_names.name: Purulent Green
palette_names.role: Secondary organic growths, infection spreading, mold clusters

palette_names.name: Off-White Mold
palette_names.role: Fungal texture highlights, spore accumulation, surface growths

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic low-key dramatic lighting with multiple bioluminescent green point sources from fungal elements, thick atmospheric haze from spore clouds diffusing light into uniform oppressive glow, occasional stark shadows from distant burning wreckage, volumetric fog reducing visibility to create depth and mystery
color_and_light.mood: Menacing, oppressive, horrific, overwhelming biological threat, coordinated hive aggression

camera.angle: Low angle dutch tilt - camera tilted slightly to enhance instability and dread, looking up at the fungal commander from ground level emphasizing dominance and scale

scenography.setting: Biologically devastated battlefield - destroyed military vehicles and structures completely consumed by aggressive fungal infestation, massive pulsating mycelial networks visible across entire terrain, ground transformed into living organism with tendrils bursting through cracked earth and concrete, both allied and enemy positions overrun by spreading infection, massive pulsating sacs attached to structures rhythmically releasing contamination spores, entire landscape breathing with alien biological rhythm
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick toxic spore clouds reducing visibility creating oppressive green haze throughout entire scene, toxic fluorescent green bioluminescent particles floating in air, visible mycelial networks pulsing with peristaltic movement, ground tentacles and fungal tendrils bursting from surfaces unpredictably, occasional large fungal sacs bursting in background releasing new contamination waves, distant flashes of bioluminescent light through spore fog, acidic green mist settling in low areas
